contentHtml:
Hello everyone! 👋 In this video, I’ll walk you through the process of taking your SketchUp model into 3ds Max and achieving stunning results using Corona Render. This is a must-watch guide, especially for those interested in architectural visualization.


What will you learn in this video? How to accurately and flawlessly import your SketchUp model into 3ds Max Corona Render.

Key techniques for using Corona Render‘s basic settings and lighting. Tips for applying materials and setting up your render for realistic results. Final touches to get your model ready for post-production.

Who is this video for? SketchUp and 3ds Max users Architectural visualization professionals and students Anyone looking to improve their rendering techniques

If you’re looking to create more effective renders with SketchUp and 3ds Max, this video is perfect for you! Don’t forget to subscribe and turn on notifications for more videos!
